$comment: Device-first accounts: ADR 0057 and ADR 0059 (bipe/docs/adr), security.md rules 5 and 6. PIN rule, reference pinProblem() in tools/lib/registries.mjs, cases in test-vectors/pins.json. A PIN is exactly pinLength ASCII digits. It is weak when all digits are the same (repeated_digit), when each digit is the previous digit plus 1 or minus 1 modulo 10 (sequence: 12345678, 87654321, 90123456), or when it is a real calendar date as DDMMYYYY or YYYYMMDD with the year from pinDateYearMin to pinDateYearMax (date). Check order: not_digits, wrong_length, repeated_digit, sequence, date. pinMaxWrongTries: wrong PINs in total, over every recovery path, before the server blocks the PIN until a reset; a correct PIN sets the count to 0. recoveryDelayHours: wait between the factor plus PIN and access (or the new PIN). guardianApprovalsMax: approvals needed = min(guardians, guardianApprovalsMax). recoveryLinkMinutes: life of the recovery link in the email. emailVerifyLinkHours: life of the link that confirms a fallback email. recoveryClaimDays: after the delay ends, the new device has this long to collect the result. Linked recovery (ADR 0096): providers are recovery factors, need the existing PIN after provider proof, wait 24 hours, and cannot reset a PIN. One account of each provider per Bipe account. flowMinutes: life of a link nonce, of a web flow and of its handoff. maxPersonalAccounts (ADR 0086): personal accounts one phone holds at most. Company accounts do not count. The API returns the live cap as max_accounts in GET /v1/me/account; this value is the fallback when the app has no answer. webLinkCooldownSeconds (ADR 0116, ADR 0118, security.md rule 5): the wait on the phone after the full-access warning and before the biometric check that approves a web sign-in by QR code. Keep it short: the Synapse rendezvous session lives 60 seconds from the QR code, and the whole approval must fit in it. recoveryReminder (bipe#531, bipe/docs/team-transfer-recovery.md section 5): the recovery-reminder card shows for an account without a Team-ID-independent factor (independent_recovery false) from firstAfterDays after the account came to this phone. Each "Agora não" hides it for the next value of snoozeDays; the last value repeats, so the card never stops for good while the account has no factor. Account deletion (ADR 0140): deletionCooldownHours is the wait between the request and the deletion; every signed-in device can cancel during it. deletionVerificationKeepDays: after a deletion the server keeps only the CPF hash and the badge record for this long, so a deleted account cannot verify again at once to get around a block (bipe-chat/bipe#528). Approval nudge (bipe-chat/bipe#628, spec device-verification): a new phone that waits for approval can send the nudge push again after approvalNudgeAgainSeconds; the server sends at most approvalNudgeMaxPerHour nudges per account.
